Voting & Elections
Voting & Elections
State Election: November 3, 2026
Wakefield residents vote at the Galvin Middle School, located at 525 Main Street.  Polls are open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
Precinct 4, 5, 6 sample ballot
Precinct 1, 2, 3, 7 sample ballot
The November 3, 2026 State Election ballot will include nine binding statewide ballot questions and one non-binding question for precincts 4, 5, and 6.. Detailed information on statewide ballot questions can be found
on the state's website
.
Early Voting Options
In-person early voting hours will take place at the Office of the Town Clerk in Town Hall, located at 1 Lafayette Street, during the following times:
Saturday, October 17 and Sunday, October 18, 2026: 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Saturday, October 24 and Sunday, October 25, 2026: 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.
Monday, October 19 through Friday, October 30, 2026: 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
Register to Vote
Residents can register to vote in three ways:
Online voter registration
Via mail using this form
, returned to our Town Clerk's office
In person at our Town Clerk's office
Absentee / Mail-in Ballots
Learn more about
absentee and mail-in voting
from the Secretary of the Commonwealth.
Accessibility
Information specific for voters with disabilities
is available from the Secretary of the Commonwealth. It includes types of equipment available, accessible voting procedures, and more.
